title: Speaking — Trying new foods
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on trying new foods.

questions: What do you enjoy doing when you have an hour to yourself?
Are your hobbies different from when you were younger?
Do your relatives share any of your interests?
Is there a hobby you would like to learn from someone?
Do you like to order unfamiliar food?
Where do you hear about new places to eat?

part2.topic: Describe a food you were unsure about but ended up enjoying.
points: what persuaded you to try it
part2.closing: and explain whether you have eaten it again.

questions: How does migration change what food is available in a city?
Can restaurants adapt traditional dishes for new customers while respecting their origins?
How has everyday life connected with trying new foods changed for people of different ages?
